_about.rules: Every value is real, copied from a published file or an upstream NOAA text at the given asOf. Do not round beyond what is shown, do not extrapolate, keep the kind word (observed/model/official/prediction). Values with availability=staging_only must only appear on protected previews. Nothing here is human-verified.

kinds.analysis: gap-free blend of instruments (MUR), not a raw measurement
kinds.model_probability: NOAA C-HARM probability of water conditions
kinds.model_outlook: Neritic statistical outlook from past composites
kinds.official_unverified: agency statement transcribed by machine, not reviewed by a person

charm.source: v1/port-intel-758401a7d3.json ports[port_code=592].charm (C-HARM v3.1, NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP wvcharmV3_0day..3day)
charm.note: Every lead of the newest run is already in the past on 2026-11-10 (valid Nov 2-5). A mock dated today must say 'past run', not 'forecast'. Medians over cells within 15 km; the port's harbour sits in C-HARM's coastal gap (nearest cell 1.98 km).
charm.must_say: Probability of conditions in the water, not toxin in seafood. No demonstrated skill at the shore.

thresholds.pseudo_nitzschia: Probability that Pseudo-nitzschia exceeds 10,000 cells per litre
thresholds.particulate_domoic: Probability that particulate domoic acid exceeds 500 ng per litre
thresholds.cellular_domoic: Probability that cellular domoic acid exceeds 10 pg per cell

charm_grid_pda_monterey.null_means: no model cell (land or coastal mask), never zero

chlorophyll.must_say: Observed chlorophyll, not toxin. Gaps are no observation, not low.

near_port.sensor: Sentinel-3 OLCI 300 m, latest clear view within 7 days
near_port.caveat: Plain median of every published pixel within 15 km; the app's place headline additionally removes shoreline and isolated-extreme pixels (src/lib/chlNear.ts), so its number can differ. Use the port-intel 8-day value below when a mock needs a figure the app itself prints.

port_intel_8day.source: v1/port-intel-758401a7d3.json ports[592].chlorophyll (VIIRS 750 m 8-day pixel median within 15 km)

chlorophyll_grid_monterey.sensor: Sentinel-3 OLCI 300 m latest clear view (each pixel has its own date)
chlorophyll_grid_monterey.downsampling: geometric mean of native 0.0025-degree pixels in each 0.01-degree block; null = no valid pixel in the block (land, cloud or gap)

gridded_analysis.source: v1/derived/index.json#sst_latest (derived/sst-2026-11-07-bbaf38db16/values/{row}_{col}.u16.gz) JPL MUR SST v4.1 via ERDDAP jplMURSST41
gridded_analysis.note: MUR is a blended analysis; it has no gaps by construction. Never label it a satellite observation of a pixel.

in_situ.source: api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov product=water_temperature, sensor 2.1 m below MLLW

waves.station: NDBC 46236 Monterey Canyon Outer (15.3 km), a wave buoy without wind

chl_outlook_8d.basis_note: All 20 cells within 15 km of Moss Landing equal the climatology exactly (ratio 1.000): the newest MODIS-Aqua composite had no clear value here, so this run carries no recent information at this port. Across the domain 69.6% of cells are climatology only (composite values in 485 of 1590 cells). The 'usual' here is a MODIS 4 km climatology near shore (about 10 mg/m3) and must not be set beside OLCI 300 m (0.69 mg/m3) as if comparable.

skill_quotable.test_period: 2019-01-09..2021-06-26 (target composites); fitted on 2003-2015, variant chosen on 2016-2018
skill_quotable.plain: Typical error about a factor of 2; held-out test.

chl_outlook_8d.must_say: Chlorophyll, not toxin. A statistical outlook, not an observation. The window started before the issue date (valid_from < issued).

cdph_crab_da.action_level_text: FDA Action Level >30 PPM, viscera, Dungeness and rock crab
cdph_crab_da.note: values_raw is what CDPH printed: '<2.5' and 'ND' are not zero. Nearby comparison (BMA F, Oct 9): Pigeon Point avg 3.9, Pillar Point avg 3.0. North coast context: Usal Oct 20 avg 38.5 max 99 (50% over action), not this port.
cdph_crab_da.must_say: Sample results from named sites and dates; a test is not a closure decision. CDPH and CDFW decide.

records_for_port_592.title: Annual quarantine of sport-harvested mussels
records_for_port_592.summary: Sport-harvested mussels from the entire California coast, including bays and estuaries, may not be harvested for human consumption (bait only).

records_for_port_592.title: Do not eat sport-harvested bivalve shellfish from Monterey County
records_for_port_592.summary: CDPH advises not eating sport-harvested mussels, clams, scallops or oysters from Monterey County because of dangerous levels of domoic acid detected in mussels.

records_for_port_592.title: Do not eat northern anchovies from Pigeon Point to Point Lobos
records_for_port_592.summary: CDPH advises not eating northern anchovies harvested between Pigeon Point (San Mateo County) and Point Lobos (Monterey County) because of dangerous levels of domoic acid. Does not apply to anchovies taken for bait.

records_for_port_592.title: Northern anchovy: no take for human consumption, Pigeon Point to Point Lobos
records_for_port_592.summary: Northern anchovies may not be harvested recreationally or commercially for human consumption in Monterey Bay (Pigeon Point to Point Lobos). Commercially taken anchovies may only be sold as dead bait; recreationally taken anchovies may only be used as bait.

conflicts_verbatim: Agency source discrepancy: CDPH release SN26-021 ("CDPH Lifts Warnings about Sport-Harvested Bivalve Shellfish from Monterey County", https://www.cdph.ca.gov/Programs/OPA/Pages/SN26-021.aspx) appears to lift active record cdph-2026-sn26-018-monterey-bivalves. Not yet reviewed by a person: the record is shown as disputed, not as confirmed active.
